text:
Maya (Support): Hey team — customer (ACME Corp, account_id: acct_84321) says AWS Marketplace credits from order mp-0-98765 never showed up in their Redwood balance. They accepted the offer last week. Can we verify entitlement/grant sync?

Liam (Cloud Ops): Can you paste the marketplace order id + the customer email? I want to check the entitlement ingestion logs.

Maya (Support): Order: mp-0-98765, email: ops@acme.com. Customer says AWS console shows the subscription is active.

Liam (Cloud Ops): Thanks. Quick check — the grant-sync job for marketplace entitlements has a recent error spike. I pulled the last 10 lines: 
```
2026-11-21T14:02:12Z grant-sync ERROR order=mp-0-98765 upstream=partner-api timeout
2026-11-21T14:02:12Z grant-sync INFO retry=1
2026-11-21T14:02:13Z grant-sync ERROR order=mp-0-98765 status=500 body="{\"error\":\"partner lookup failed\"}"
```
Looks like partner-api returned 500 during ingestion window.

Sophie (Partner Ops): @Liam good catch. I can check partner webhook retries. Which vendor is this? AWS Marketplace or a partner accelerator?

Maya (Support): AWS Marketplace via our marketplace integration (not accelerator).

Sophie (Partner Ops): I confirmed with the vendor mapping: vendor_id aws-marketplace-01. Their webhook health shows intermittent 5xx yesterday between 13:58-14:06 UTC. Our retry loop kept failing. I opened a ticket with marketplace vendor.

Andrew (Billing): On the billing ledger there is no credit line for acct_84321 and mp-0-98765 — the entitlement never created an internal grant. I pulled the ledger query: `SELECT * FROM credits WHERE source_order = 'mp-0-98765'` -> zero rows.

Maya (Support): Customer is asking for ETA. They are blocked from using trial credits. Can we apply a temporary manual credit and track it?

Liam (Cloud Ops): We can provision a manual grant. Prefer to add an audit entry and then run the grant-sync again to reconcile when vendor is back. I can run a targeted re-ingest for that order after vendor fix.

reconcile-bot: grant-sync restarted by Liam at 2026-11-21T14:07:31Z. 3 failures in last 24h.

Liam (Cloud Ops): I ran a quick check against the entitlements queue: `redis-cli lrange ent_sync_errors 0 -1` returned `[{"order":"mp-0-98765","error":"500 partner lookup"}]`. Confirmed.

Andrew (Billing): To avoid double-crediting: if you do a manual grant, mark it as `manual_temp` and include a reconciliation tag `recon:mp-0-98765`. We'll remove/convert it when the official grant arrives.

Maya (Support): I'll request authorization from Escalations to apply manual credit of $250 (5k tokens equiv). @Andrew can you approve?

Andrew (Billing): Approved. Please include the audit note and forward the vendor ticket ID when available.

Maya (Support): Done — applied manual credit, id credit_manual_20261121_01, amount $250, note: "temp credit for mp-0-98765 pending vendor grant". Customer notified, they confirmed they see credits in console.

Sophie (Partner Ops): Vendor reopened their webhook and reported a backlog; they pushed the missing entitlement events at 14:28 UTC. I see our ingestion consumer accepted the event for mp-0-98765 and created entitlement record ent_99421.

Liam (Cloud Ops): Reconciliation step: I ran `./scripts/reconcile_entitlements --order mp-0-98765 --dry-run=false`. It found no conflicting active credit lines aside from manual_temp. I marked the manual grant for conversion to platform credit and linked `credit_manual_20261121_01 -> ent_99421`.

reconcile-bot: reconciliation job completed. manual_grant converted -> official ent_99421.

Andrew (Billing): I updated the ledger: replaced manual_temp entry with official credit row, kept audit trail. No double-billing.

Maya (Support): Customer confirmed they can use the credits and thanked support. They want the vendor ticket #VND-7321 for their records — Sophie, can you drop that here?

Sophie (Partner Ops): Vendor ticket VND-7321 created with vendor. I added a note to vendor: please alert us if future webhook 5xx for marketplace subscriptions.

Maya (Support): Closing on our side once I get final confirmation from the customer that everything is normal. For postmortem: Liam, can you add a short blurb to incidents about transient partner-api 500 and the retry/backoff behavior?

Liam (Cloud Ops): Yep — will add incident note and a follow-up to add more aggressive alerting on partner webhook 5xx rate.

Maya (Support): Thanks all — marking as resolved for Support. :white_check_mark:
